nodes.label: Performance Review
nodes.author: Claude
nodes.rationale: 35+ CRUD files call scalars().all() without pagination — high risk at scale. Cold start takes 2-3s due to 100+ model imports. Seed runs 459 permission upserts on every backend start.

nodes.label: Unbounded Query Risk (35+ CRUD files)
nodes.rationale: 35+ CRUD files use scalars().all() with no pagination. High-risk files: audit.py, finance.py. Fix: add limit/offset parameters to all list functions and endpoints.
